items.title: Patchwork Reindeer Plush Toy
items.alt: Seated brown-and-cream patchwork reindeer plush with stitched hooves, soft felt antlers and a red-and-green checked scarf.
items.description: A central stitched seam runs down the toy's cream belly. Floppy ears, embroidered eyes and soft rounded hooves distinguish the fabric animal from a live reindeer.

items.title: Wooden Reindeer Rocking Toy
items.alt: Carved wooden reindeer toy with a green saddle, red neck bow and two complete curved wooden rockers.
items.description: Wood grain follows the toy's rounded body and antlers. Visible crossbars join the curved rockers below four shaped wooden hooves.

items.title: Layered Paper Reindeer Wreath
items.alt: Circular layered-paper holly wreath with a stylized reindeer face at the lower center, red berries and two cream paper bells.
items.description: Folded leaf edges give the green ring depth around its open center. Brown paper antlers rise from a simple cream-muzzled reindeer face beneath the berry clusters.

items.title: Reindeer-Shaped Iced Cookie
items.alt: Large brown-iced reindeer cookie reclining on a cream napkin, with gold antlers and a green icing scarf.
items.description: A golden biscuit edge outlines the curled resting pose. Cream hoof details, tiny white back dots and the scarf's piped pattern distinguish the festive biscuit.

items.title: Amber Glass Reindeer Ornament
items.alt: Full-body amber glass reindeer ornament hanging from a gold loop with a red ribbon bow above its antlers.
items.description: Faceted translucent glass catches warm highlights across the small reindeer's torso. Gold-capped antlers and delicate glass hooves complete the decorative figure.

items.title: Merry Christmas Greeting with a Reindeer
items.alt: Red, green and cream MERRY CHRISTMAS lettering topped with holly, with a small sleeping reindeer curled beside the final letters.
items.description: Snow caps, stars and gold scrolls decorate the two-line greeting. A little green-scarved reindeer rests at the upper right with its eyes closed.
